Hey, kid!{01 00 00 05 00} What's your story?{01 00 00 0a 00}


What're you doin', loiterin'
in a place like this on a
Sunday afternoon?!
When I was your age,{01 00 00 05 00} I was
tunnelin' through hot gravel
on the weekends.
I'd go from one end of the
village to the other.{01 00 00 05 00} An' it
was uphill both ways!
You know what I got for a
full day's work?{01 00 00 05 00} 10 Bells.{01 00 00 05 00}
You know what I did then?
I'd take my 10 Bells to the
corner store an' buy salt-
water taffy and comics.
{07 38 00}But now?{01 01 00} Kids THESE days?{01 00 00 05 00}
They're like little leeches,
spongin' off their parents.{01 00 00 05 00}
And then they sit around
cafes doin' nothin'{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Little punks!

Ahh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Nothin' like a cuppa
java on the way home.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Whatta day{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
We got scrambled outta HQ
at the crack of dawn this
morning, you believe that?
Some cheatin' punk reset
the system, and BAM!{01 00 00 05 00} There
goes a perfectly nice day.
But hey, {01 00 00 05 00}that's this mole's
job,{01 00 00 0a 00} and I gotta do it{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

Yeah, I'm here again, but
lemme tell ya, I ain't eatin'
out 'cause I want to!
I'm on the job 24/7. {01 00 00 05 00}And
holidays?{01 00 00 05 00} Forget about it!{01 00 00 05 00}
No rest for the weary.
And then there's the
missus{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Sleeps 'til noon
an' never makes me lunch!
That ain't the way it was
when we was first married,
know what I mean?{01 00 00 05 00}

WHAT? {01 00 00 05 00}You know, you're like
one of them mosquitoes,
always buzzin' around...
You antagonizin' me on
purpose, or you got
somethin' you wanna ask?{02 00 00 14 18}
Talk to me!
Nope, sorry...

Quit wanderin' around in
here, ya little zombie! {01 00 00 05 00}Get
outside an' do somethin'!

You still here?{01 00 00 0a 00} I thought I
told you to SCRAM, punk!

{07 38 00}You know this crazy music
they got playin' in here?

It's one more reason that
today's kids are nothin' but
cheatin' punks!

{07 38 00}Everybody I meet's runnin'
around like they got dirt in
their ears.

I'm tellin' you for the last
time, kids shouldn't be
lookin' after other kids!

He ain't nothin' but a power
hitter, right? {01 00 00 14 00}It ain't even
worth talkin' about!

And stop blamin' everythin'
on the schools! {01 00 00 05 00}They're
doin' the best they can!

All this talk about bein' on
the winnin' team or the
losin' team...
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 38 00}Lemme tell ya, ain't nobody
but young punks give a clod
for THAT nonsense!

{01 00 00 05 00}{07 38 00}What's your problem, punk?{01 00 00 05 00}
You don't understand mole?

I ain't got nothin' to talk
to you about.

Yeah, {01 00 00 0a 00}I think that's best
for everyone involved.

All right, {01 00 00 0a 00}I think I'm gonna
pack it in for the day.

All right, listen up...{01 00 00 0a 00}
You're really startin' to
bug me, understand?
Why don't you, uh, go
somewhere?{01 00 00 05 00} Go catch a fish
or somethin'.

{ff 00 00 02}Do all the stuff you gotta
do to get ready for
tomorrow{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.today!

{ff 00 00 02}Look both ways before you
cross the street, punk!

{ff 00 00 02}Turn your library books in
on time, lazybones!

{ff 00 00 02}Wipe your feet before you
go inside, dirt-monster!

{ff 00 00 02}Change your sheets once in
a while, smelly! Sheesh!

{ff 00 00 02}Eat your vegetables, and
put your dishes in the sink!
{ff 00 00 02}STAY OFF MY LAWN!!!
{ff 00 00 02}Take out the garbage!
